<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary proceedings:</strong> The Lok Sabha has initiated discussions on the Union Budget and the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation (Amendment) Bill, 2026, while Speaker Om Birla remains absent pending the resolution of a no-confidence motion.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOZ3NyRmdBaFBqMXpvbFZ3blhmVWozVDlKRkprVUdsSGhGbFVWdFBjeFk4WFh2ckhLb2FiSGhMVF82YVdoeWkyaHBiLTc0RlBZcTg2WEhXdzkyWlFSYzZSZkZzTTlseDhqZ3JDdHRMUjFkNDRDTDZUMFhpQ3dGMGpyQm5QdVlDR05DS0Nyb05xU2cyVXFtVmZYWXZQZmozV1FPU3dEdmVwTDlfUkh0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP electoral strategy:</strong> The BJP has announced nine candidates for the Rajya Sabha across six states, while party leadership pushes for a coalition-focused strategy in Andhra Pradesh ahead of local elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNaVhocTRXcTFZVHNGTHZRVEYyZXBfM0VIa0wzbUNUaGJjRS0zeEV6akpHUmxOMmhyaHRMNERTWW4td2hkMW8zcUZnR1poMllnUnJ1YjYycEZ4T052T2p6YjhRell2R1RHU0doVHo0d1AtdGE2dHBhM3dheUVwcUZtRmRDU3B6UDdKSnc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legal and constitutional matters:</strong> The Delhi Police has informed the Supreme Court that the recent Parliament march was illegal and denied the use of excessive force, while the Goa government has appealed to the Supreme Court to enhance the jail term for Tarun Tejpal.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNZWFHN3dnLTBpTXhfbUZralRoZGlwcUVIOUYyQUdBV3BuT2E4LUlQRUtjZndaZDJCWDZrd3prWGZJR1Zuc1FWVURrZ1l5WHpVemdJUFpzdXFwVnV2NENHMTIwR0V0NVc3TjNKNU5IR2otejM2V2lyQUJTd1BUUjMwREVTVTFNdnZPYWJpUzdXZzBEY2F0LUtiREl1Unlsc1BRRGdWZ2dvTE0wV0FLOWY4?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Institutional oversight:</strong> The Election Commission has released a comprehensive fact sheet detailing India’s electoral system and voter safeguards, even as the Centre defends the NEET exam system as &quot;foolproof&quot; before the Supreme Court.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Governance and reforms:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved ten administrative reforms, and the government is actively studying industrial policy models to drive national economic development.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
</ul>
